prompts.actors:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game character sprite atlas, transparent PNG, portrait 1024x1536.
Primary request: EXACTLY twelve separate full-body action poses, arranged in a STRICT regular grid of 3 equal columns and 4 equal rows. Every cell contains exactly one actor. Maintain fixed body scale across all twelve cells, with standard standing height about 260 pixels in a 384px-high cell. Feet/resting body ground contact baseline at 90% of each cell height. Leave generous fully transparent gutters, at least 20 pixels to each cell edge. Whole long weapons and all cloth must fit INSIDE their own cell, no overlap between cells. No gridlines.
Style/medium: original angular inked and hand-painted Greek underworld fantasy illustration with graphic cel shading, 2-3 strong shading levels, crisp sculptural silhouettes and expressive fighting gestures, a dark mythic graphic-novel game aesthetic inspired by Hades. Human proportions about five to six heads tall, mature athletic build; must remain legible when the body is only 140 pixels high. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealism, NOT 3D, NOT chibi. This is original art: do not copy existing Hades characters, costumes, logos or game assets.
Color palette: charcoal and olive black outlines and shadows, bone ivory, antique gold and bronze, deep crimson cloth and fire, deep teal and jade magic.
Hero design for rows 1 and 2: one identical original Greek underworld exile, dark curly hair, bronze cuirass, ivory asymmetric tunic, crimson flowing sash, long bronze sword with restrained fiery orange edge, small black-and-gold round shield. Bare human face. No red laurel and no skull shoulder costume. All six hero poses FACE RIGHT with rightward gaze and readable side-view / slight three-quarter profiles.
Rival design for rows 3 and 4: one identical original masked armoured shade, bronze helmet and mask, deep teal drape, dark armour, long spear with glowing jade edge. All six rival poses FACE LEFT with leftward gaze and side-view / slight three-quarter profiles.
Exact cell order, left to right and top to bottom:
ROW 1: hero idle ready stance; hero sword windup (sword raised back, preparing rightward swing); hero strike (lunging and swinging sword toward RIGHT).
ROW 2: hero guard (round shield raised toward RIGHT); hero hurt (recoiling from a blow received from RIGHT); hero death (collapsed low on the ground, head toward RIGHT, no blood).
ROW 3: rival idle with spear; rival windup (spear drawn back, preparing leftward thrust); rival strike (lunging and extending spear toward LEFT).
ROW 4: rival guard facing LEFT; rival hurt (recoiling from a blow received from LEFT); rival death (collapsed low on ground, head toward LEFT, no blood).
Keep scale identical; death poses are naturally lower, not enlarged. Use diagonals for the long sword and spear wherever needed to preserve complete weapons and gutters. Weapon belongs to and moves with each actor.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha everywhere outside each figure and its equipment; do not simulate transparency with a checkerboard or flat color. No ground, cast shadow, background, frame, text, label, UI, watermark, extra objects or extra actors.
prompts.arena:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide 16:9 game arena backdrop, ideally 1536x864 landscape.
Primary request: an original antique Greek underworld palace courtyard serving as the background for a SIDE VIEW duel. Eye-level side-on stage composition, NOT isometric and NOT top-down. A broad clear uninterrupted foreground fighting floor runs horizontally across the lower quarter of the image. The lower middle must be open and relatively quiet so two small fighters remain readable, with no obstacles in their fighting area.
Scene/backdrop: imposing black basalt Greek columns framing the LEFT and RIGHT sides, antique gold meander carvings and ornate classical reliefs, jade and teal green-flame braziers, sparse red lava accents confined along the sides, a recessed central ancient doorway with deep layered architecture. Detailed ornate background frames the clear stage. Painted depth with warm peripheral lava glints and eerie teal light, restrained highlights on worn stone.
Style/medium: original angular inked and hand-painted underworld fantasy game illustration with graphic cel-shaded planes, expressive brush edges, rich layered mythic atmosphere inspired by Hades; NOT pixels, NOT photorealism, NOT 3D. Do not copy any exact Hades game location or game art.
Color palette: charcoal and olive black basalt, bone highlights, antique gold, deep crimson lava, teal and jade magical fire.
Constraints: background only, no actors, no creatures, no UI, no text or lettering, no logos, no watermark. Keep the central bottom fighting floor clear and horizontal. Fill the full image; opaque background.
prompts.icons:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game inventory and match-3 icon atlas, transparent PNG, landscape 4:3, ideally 1536x1152.
Primary request: EXACTLY twelve separate original Greek underworld fantasy game icons in a STRICT grid of 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows. One icon centered in each cell, consistent visual scale. Every icon including all glow must fit inside the central 75% of its cell width and height, leaving generous fully transparent gutters; icons must never touch or overlap. No visible grid or tile frames.
Exact cell order from left to right:
ROW 1: crimson bronze sword; blue aegis shield; violet lightning crystal; gold laurel medallion.
ROW 2: green poison flask; black fire bomb; red heart; gold obol coin.
ROW 3: red nectar vial; teal relic amulet; gold laurel crown; white-and-gold four-point star.
Appearance: strong clear silhouettes, crisp angular black ink contours, hand-painted rich flat color planes with 2-3 strong cel-shading levels, concise antique Greek ornamental details, saturated family colors for instant recognition at small match-3 tile sizes. The sword is an antique bronze sword with crimson energy; blue shield visually distinct from green poison; medallion circular with embossed laurel; poison flask squat green bottle; bomb round near-black with burning fuse; heart vivid red; obol antique gold circular coin; nectar slim red stoppered vial; relic teal pendant with gold mount; laurel crown open leafy gold wreath; star exactly four bright points.
Style/medium: original angular hand-painted inked Greek underworld fantasy aesthetic inspired by Hades, matching an ornate charcoal, bronze and teal game world. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealism, NOT 3D, NOT emoji. Do not copy exact Hades game icons, logos or assets.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha outside each individual icon; no simulated checkerboard or flat backdrop. No ground or cast shadow, tile background, square backing, frame, text, labels, watermark, extra symbols or extra icons.
